capabilities: Open or create today's daily note from a ribbon icon or command
Capture one-sentence entries appended to today's note
Track streaks with 0-2 weekly freezes that don't break the chain
Show a 16-week heatmap, current and best streak, and comeback stats
Generate a shareable image card of the streak and heatmap
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store (pending approval); installable via BRAT or manually. Makes no network requests and stores all data locally.
motivation: The author built it on the idea that people stop journaling because of friction and guilt, not lack of motivation, so the plugin makes starting and returning easy and never punishes you.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track a daily writing habit, and people abandon journaling because of friction and guilt over missed days.

relations.evidence: if your daily template contains Templater syntax (<% %>), Racha doesn't copy it raw

summary: Daily journaling streak tracker that opens today's note in one click, counts words, and adds freezes, a heatmap, stats and a shareable card.
